title: What Was There Before / Was vorher da war
description:
An interactive web-based artwork that makes the writing process visible as a palimpsest: tempo, pauses, deletions, additions and the trail of the mouse are recorded in the browser and turned into a layered image and a navigable space of time. Runs entirely in the browser; no data is transmitted.

Ein interaktives, webbasiertes Kunstwerk, das den Schreibprozess als Palimpsest sichtbar macht.
